citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 9:15 am on
6/25/2026. The inspector was able to reach the licensee by phone at the primary contact phone number. The licensee
stated they were at work location and not available for inspection.
Failure to provide access to the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations.
Continued failure to provide access is serious and may result in enforcement action.
End Section
